council_map.vintage: City says districts were approved by the council in 2022 redistricting; layer names end 07262022
council_map.notes: City-run MapServer with SIX layers, one polygon per district (ids 0-5 = D1..D6; names like GIS_ENG.SDE.D1_2016_3_07262022). Each layer's returnCountOnly -> {"count":1}; field District is an integer 1..6; Officehold holds the member name. Union the six layers to get the map. Names in the layers match the council page. Saved: raw/terre-haute-in/ts-layer0..5-attrs.json, mapserver.json. The city's interactive web app (terrehaute.maps.arcgis.com, id e03b22885b7440fe9de839746271219c) points to this MapServer and to a separate 68-polygon grid layer (Council_Districts FeatureServer, grid cells, not districts).

notes: Council page: 2026 President Anthony Dinkel, Vice-President Amanda Thompson; says 'three at large members'. Staff directory lists a 'City Judge' row (name not read), so a city court exists. The district seats and numbers come from the district-maps page and the staff directory. No appointments shown.
